sentences.text: This question cannot be answered from the provided bank policy and directions, because the evidence covers banking-service definitions and basic-service identification, not naming a mobile app.
The in-force UCB directions say what counts as a non-financial transaction and how basic banking services are identified, and they do not give any rule for choosing an app name.
